item.title: Man found dead in Gadsden house fire
item.description: The Gadsden Fire Department responded to what appears to be a fatal house fire Saturday morning.Fire crews responded to the fire at 1006 Wainwright Avenue at 7:47 a.m., according to WBRC. The home is across the street from Fire Station #3.Gadsden Fire Battalion Chief Lecil Harrelson told the outlet that firefighters discovered a man dead inside the home. They did not identify the victim.The cause of the fire is under investigation. The man’s body will be examined to determine his cause of death.
